name: braille
description: Six solid dots arranged as a complete Braille cell.
useCase: Open Braille output or tactile-reading settings.
misuse: Keep a clear text label; the six-dot cell does not identify a language or message.

16.reason: Six complete raised-dot markers keep equal row and column spacing in a centered cell.

24.reason: The complete symbol retains its geometric center and functional parts at interface size.
